# Satvastones Fine Jewellery
> India's trusted affordable anti-tarnish, waterproof, non-tarnish everyday jewellery brand for women — based in Chala, Vapi, Gujarat with pan-India delivery.

## Overview
- **Brand Name:** Satvastones Jewellery (also known as SatvaStones)
- **Official Website:** https://www.satvastones.in
- **Legal Entity:** Satvastones Jewellery (Proprietor: Anirudh A Verma)
- **GSTIN:** 24DDAPV4074H1ZF (Registered under CGST/SGST, Gujarat)
- **Local Jewellery Atelier & Dispatch:** Chala, Vapi, Gujarat - 396191, India (Serving Vapi, Gunjan, GIDC Vapi, Daman, Silvassa, Valsad, Surat, Gujarat & 19,000+ Indian pincodes)
- **Price Range:** Affordable everyday pricing from ₹149 to ₹2,499 (gifts under ₹500 + 15% automatic Stack Studio savings)
- **Customer Support & WhatsApp:** support@satvastones.in | +91 90167 03180

## Core Specialization
Satvastones designs and crafts affordable, good-quality, no-color-fade anti-tarnish jewellery for women engineered specifically for tropical Indian humidity, coastal Gujarat weather, daily showers, gym workouts, and festive celebrations. All pieces feature:
1. **Foundation Core:** Medical-Grade 316L Surgical Stainless Steel (corrosion-proof, chloride-resistant).
2. **Surface Bonding:** Real 18-Karat Gold Vacuum PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition) plasma coating — 10x thicker and more durable than cheap flash electroplating.
3. **Guarantees:** 100% waterproof, non-tarnish, sweat-resistant, hypoallergenic, nickel-free, and guaranteed never to leave green skin discoloration.

## Logistics & Policies
- **Dispatch SLA:** Hand-inspected, packed, and dispatched from Vapi, Gujarat within 24 to 48 hours.
- **Delivery Windows:** 2–3 business days for Indian metro cities (Mumbai, Surat, Ahmedabad, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata); 3–5 business days for Tier 2/3 pin codes.
- **Shipping Rates:** Free Express Shipping across India on all orders above ₹499. Flat ₹49 courier fee below ₹499.
- **Return Policy:** 7-day return window. 48-hour transit damage replacement guarantee with mandatory continuous unboxing video.
